market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 during the 2026 World Cup and has a lengthy injury history, including an ACL tear in 2023. While he is likely to be selected if fit, his injury risk over the next 18 months is substantial, reducing the true probability below the market's 82%. I estimate a ~70% chance he takes the field in an official match.
evidence_points: Neymar suffered a serious ACL injury in October 2023, missing almost a year of action.
He has returned to form at Santos in 2025, but his age and past injuries increase the risk of further setbacks.
Brazil's attacking depth (Vinicius Jr, Rodrygo, etc.) might not prevent his selection if healthy, but the primary risk is physical.
